proposals.evidence: Turner mātṛ explicitly gives Hindi maiyā, Assamese māu and the māya/māi family. The surveyed mother forms match these ordinary regional continuations; the source-internal spacing of māī yā and ma u is preserved and read as the attested kin term, not two independently inherited lexical members.
